text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian institute for political-legal research says the 30.29 percent of voters who are still undecided will determine the winner in local elections on November 17.
- The new criminal law in Macedonia goes into effect today. Life imprisonment the most severe penalty.
- There are 1,498,479 registered voters, justice minister Vlado Popovski said.
- The European commissioner for energy Hristos Papucis will visit Macedonia on Saturday to meet Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski and other officials.
- Presidents of the chambers of commerce of Macedonia and Yugoslavia, Dusan Petreski and Mihajlo Milojevic, sign cooperation agreement in Belgrade.
